Implemented analysis in code/analyze_flame_pressure.py (fits linear/quadratic/power/exponential models, LOOCV RMSE + AIC comparison, bootstrap uncertainty, residual diagnostics) and report generator code/generate_report.py. Generated figures (PNG) in report/images/ and wrote publication-style report to report/report.md. Saved intermediate outputs in outputs/ (model_comparison.csv, best_model_params.json, data_overview.json).
